experiments.title: Acetic Acid + Sodium Bicarbonate
experiments.fixedConditions: 15 mL 5% Acetic Acid + 10 mL 0.5 M Sodium Bicarbonate, open beaker, ambient 22 C.
experiments.rationale: Weak organic acid and mild bicarbonate salt; gentle endothermic CO2 effervescence.
experiments.observations: Steady CO2 gas bubbling; clear colourless solution remains.
experiments.safetyNotes: Never seal vessel during CO2 evolution.
experiments.educationalOutcome: Demonstrates weak acid-carbonate reaction and gas evolution.

experiments.title: Dilute Neutralisation: HCl + NaOH
experiments.fixedConditions: 10 mL 0.10 M HCl + 10 mL 0.10 M NaOH, ambient 22 C.
experiments.rationale: Virtual simulation only. Dilute 0.10 M strong acid-base neutralisation; both stock chemicals remain corrosive hazards.
experiments.observations: No strong visual change; small exothermic temperature rise occurs.
experiments.safetyNotes: Both stock reagents are corrosive; virtual acknowledgement required.
experiments.educationalOutcome: Idealised strong acid-strong base neutralisation forming aqueous salt and water.

experiments.title: Citric Acid + Calcium Carbonate
experiments.fixedConditions: 15 mL 0.10 M Citric Acid + 10 mL CaCO3 suspension, open beaker, ambient 22 C.
experiments.rationale: Mild organic acid reacting slowly with insoluble carbonate salt.
experiments.observations: Gentle effervescence as CO2 bubbles release from suspension.
experiments.safetyNotes: Use open vessel and standard eye protection.
experiments.educationalOutcome: Illustrates organic acid reaction with mineral carbonate.

experiments.title: Acetic Acid + Magnesium Hydroxide
experiments.fixedConditions: 15 mL 5% Acetic Acid + 10 mL Mg(OH)2 suspension, ambient 22 C.
experiments.rationale: Weak acid neutralising a mild, sparingly soluble hydroxide suspension with minimal heat.
experiments.observations: Milky suspension gradually clears as soluble magnesium acetate forms.
experiments.safetyNotes: Low acute hazard under dilute virtual preset.
experiments.educationalOutcome: Demonstrates antacid-style neutralisation of a weak base suspension.

experiments.title: Dilute Neutralisation: HCl + KOH
experiments.fixedConditions: 10 mL 0.10 M HCl + 10 mL 0.10 M KOH, ambient 22 C.
experiments.rationale: Dilute strong acid + strong caustic alkali; exothermic neutralisation requiring acknowledgement.
experiments.observations: Clear solution with mild heat release.
experiments.safetyNotes: KOH and HCl stocks are corrosive; virtual acknowledgement required.
experiments.educationalOutcome: Demonstrates strong acid-base neutralisation yielding potassium chloride.

experiments.title: Citric Acid + Calcium Hydroxide
experiments.fixedConditions: 15 mL 0.10 M Citric Acid + 15 mL Ca(OH)2 (limewater), ambient 22 C.
experiments.rationale: Ca(OH)2 is an alkaline eye/skin irritant; requires PPE acknowledgement.
experiments.observations: Cloudy limewater neutralises with gentle warming.
experiments.safetyNotes: Avoid eye contact with alkaline Ca(OH)2.
experiments.educationalOutcome: Shows triprotic organic acid neutralisation of an alkaline earth hydroxide.

experiments.title: Sulfuric Acid + Sodium Hydroxide (Blocked)
experiments.fixedConditions: 10 mL 1.0 M H2SO4 + 10 mL 1.0 M NaOH (HIGH RISK — BLOCKED).
controls: BLOCKED: High exothermic & corrosive splash hazard
experiments.rationale: Strong diprotic acid + strong base produces rapid exothermic heat and corrosive splash risk. Mixing blocked.
experiments.safetyNotes: Use Smart Safety Advisor to switch to a safer dilute neutralisation preset.
experiments.educationalOutcome: Identifies high exothermic hazard of concentrated mineral acid-base mixing.

experiments.title: Sulfuric Acid + Potassium Hydroxide (Blocked)
experiments.fixedConditions: 10 mL 1.0 M H2SO4 + 10 mL 1.0 M KOH (HIGH RISK — BLOCKED).
experiments.rationale: Violent exothermic reaction between strong diprotic acid and caustic alkali; severe burn/splash hazard. Mixing blocked.
experiments.safetyNotes: Use Smart Safety Advisor for safer reviewed alternatives.
experiments.educationalOutcome: Demonstrates why strong acid-alkali combinations are restricted.

experiments.title: Sulfuric Acid + Sodium Bicarbonate (Blocked)
experiments.fixedConditions: 10 mL 1.0 M H2SO4 + 10 mL NaHCO3 (HIGH RISK — BLOCKED).
controls: BLOCKED: Vigorous CO2 foaming & acid misting hazard
experiments.rationale: Rapid exothermic reaction produces vigorous CO2 foaming and corrosive acid aerosol mist. Mixing blocked.
experiments.safetyNotes: Use Smart Safety Advisor to switch to Acetic Acid + Sodium Bicarbonate (LOW risk).
experiments.educationalOutcome: Illustrates acid strength impact on gas-evolution hazard.
